content.data:
Tudo pronto! O **DeepSeek Code** foi implementado em `/home/marcelo/deepseek-code` com:

**18 arquivos criados:**
- `src/index.tsx` — entrypoint com shebang, valida a API key
- `src/agent.ts` — loop de agente com streaming e tool calls
- `src/tools/` — 7 tools: WriteFile, ReadFile, ReadFolder, Grep, Glob, Shell, Introspect
- `src/ui/` — 5 componentes Ink: App, MessageList, ToolUseDisplay, InputBox, StatusBar

**Para usar:**
```bash
export DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sua-chave-aqui
cd /home/marcelo/deepseek-code
bun src/index.tsx
```

A verificação confirmou que o app inicia corretamente e exibe um erro claro quando a API key não está configurada. Quando configurada, abre a TUI com input, histórico de mensagens, display de tool calls em tempo real e status bar — interface similar ao Claude Code.

Funciona. O erro de "Raw mode" só ocorre fora de um terminal real — é o comportamento correto do Ink. Pronto!

---

Feito. Aqui está o que foi implementado:

**`src/ui/ApiKeySetup.tsx`** — tela de setup com:
- Mensagem de boas-vindas + link para obter a chave
- Campo de input mascarado com `•` (igual ao Claude Code)
- Salva em `~/.deepseek-code/config.json` e seta `process.env.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` imediatamente
- Enter confirma, Esc sai

**`src/index.tsx`** — lógica de inicialização:
1. Verifica `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` no ambiente
2. Se não tiver, tenta carregar de `~/.deepseek-code/config.json`
3. Se ainda não tiver, mostra a tela de setup
4. Após configurar, entra direto no chat

Na próxima vez que rodar, a chave já estará salva e o app abre direto no chat — igual ao Claude Code.

Não, o modelo configurado é `deepseek-chat` — que é o nome correto da API da DeepSeek para o modelo principal (equivalente ao DeepSeek-V3). O `deepseek-code-v2` não é um nome de modelo válido na API deles.

Os modelos disponíveis na DeepSeek API são:
- `deepseek-chat` — modelo principal (DeepSeek-V3)
- `deepseek-reasoner` — modelo de raciocínio (DeepSeek-R1)

Quer trocar para `deepseek-reasoner` ou manter o `deepseek-chat`?

Confirmado pela documentação oficial. A DeepSeek API expõe **apenas dois modelos**:

| Model | Versão real | Descrição |
|---|---|---|
| `deepseek-chat` | DeepSeek-V3.2 (Non-thinking) | Modo chat padrão, rápido, 8K output máx |
| `deepseek-reasoner` | DeepSeek-V3.2 (Thinking) | Modo raciocínio passo a passo, 64K output máx |

Ambos rodam o mesmo modelo base (DeepSeek-V3.2, 128K contexto), mas o `deepseek-reasoner` ativa o modo de "thinking" — equivalente ao o1 da OpenAI.

O projeto está usando `deepseek-chat`, que é a escolha certa para um assistente de código interativo. Quer trocar para `deepseek-reasoner` ou manter?

content.data: Claude, eu quero fazer um sistesma CLI completo, em que o DeepSeek possa ler os diretórios, arquivos, etc, possa escrever, possa usar o shell, etc. Teremos as seguintes tools: WriteFile, ReadFile, ReadFolder (apenas lista os arquivos de uma pasta), Grep, Glob, Shell, Instrospect (um documento em que ele descobre tudo sobre o sistema dele). O CLI se chamará "DeepSeek Code". Quero que ele tenha a interface similar ao Claude Code (/home/marcelo/ai-code). Crie a task detalhadamente, e chame o gpt via subagent para ele implementar. Sinta-se livre para me perguntar qualquer coisa!

stages.prompt_template:
You are a senior TypeScript developer. Implement the **DeepSeek Code CLI** from scratch at `/home/marcelo/deepseek-code`.

## Overview
A full-featured AI coding assistant CLI (like Claude Code) that uses the DeepSeek API. Built with TypeScript + Ink (React for terminal) + Bun runtime.

## Reference
The Claude Code project lives at `/home/marcelo/ai-code`. Study its structure for inspiration, especially:
- `/home/marcelo/ai-code/src/tools/GlobTool/GlobTool.ts` — tool pattern
- `/home/marcelo/ai-code/src/tools/BashTool/BashTool.tsx` — shell tool pattern
- `/home/marcelo/ai-code/src/tools/FileReadTool/FileReadTool.ts` — file read pattern
- `/home/marcelo/ai-code/src/entrypoints/cli.tsx` — CLI entrypoint pattern

## Project Structure to Create
```
/home/marcelo/deepseek-code/
  package.json
  tsconfig.json
  bunfig.toml
  src/
    index.tsx              # CLI entrypoint (bun src/index.tsx)
    agent.ts               # Core agent loop (streaming, tool calls)
    tools/
      index.ts             # Exports all tools
      types.ts             # Tool interface types
      WriteFile.ts
      ReadFile.ts
      ReadFolder.ts
      Grep.ts
      Glob.ts
      Shell.ts
      Introspect.ts
    ui/
      App.tsx              # Main Ink app component
      MessageList.tsx      # Chat history display
      ToolUseDisplay.tsx   # Shows tool calls in progress/done
      InputBox.tsx         # User input component
      StatusBar.tsx        # Bottom status bar (model, tokens, etc.)
```

## Tech Stack
- Runtime: **Bun** (use `bun` for all commands)
- Language: TypeScript with strict mode
- UI: **Ink 5** (React for terminal) + React 18
- AI: **openai** npm package pointed at DeepSeek API (`https://api.deepseek.com`)
- Schema validation: **zod**
- Shell execution: **execa**
- Colors: **chalk**
- File glob: **fast-glob** or Node's built-in glob

## package.json
```json
{
  "name": "deepseek-code",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "type": "module",
  "bin": { "deepseek-code": "./src/index.tsx" },
  "scripts": {
    "start": "bun src/index.tsx",
    "dev": "bun --watch src/index.tsx"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "chalk": "^5.3.0",
    "execa": "^9.0.0",
    "fast-glob": "^3.3.2",
    "ink": "^5.0.1",
    "openai": "^4.52.0",
    "react": "^18.3.1",
    "zod": "^3.23.8"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/react": "^18.3.3",
    "typescript": "^5.5.3"
  }
}
```

## Core Architecture

### Tool Interface (`src/tools/types.ts`)
```typescript
export interface Tool {
  name: string
  description: string
  parameters: Record<string, unknown> // JSON Schema
  execute(args: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<string>
}
```

### Agent Loop (`src/agent.ts`)
- Uses OpenAI SDK with `baseURL: 'https://api.deepseek.com'`
- Model: `deepseek-chat` (or `deepseek-coder`)
- API key from `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` env var
- Streaming with `stream: true`
- Handles tool calls in a loop until no more tool calls
- Emits events: `onToken(text)`, `onToolCall(name, args)`, `onToolResult(name, result)`, `onDone()`
- Maintains conversation history (messages array)
- System prompt: explains it's DeepSeek Code, a coding assistant with file/shell access

### Tools Implementation

**WriteFile** (`src/tools/WriteFile.ts`)
- Parameters: `path: string`, `content: string`
- Creates parent dirs if needed (`mkdir -p`)
- Returns: `"File written: {path} ({bytes} bytes)"`

**ReadFile** (`src/tools/ReadFile.ts`)
- Parameters: `path: string`, `start_line?: number`, `end_line?: number`
- Returns file content (optionally sliced by line range)
- Max 10000 lines, truncates with notice if larger

**ReadFolder** (`src/tools/ReadFolder.ts`)
- Parameters: `path: string`, `recursive?: boolean` (default false)
- Lists files/dirs in the folder (NOT recursive by default)
- Returns formatted list with file sizes and types
- Excludes `node_modules`, `.git` by default

**Grep** (`src/tools/Grep.ts`)
- Parameters: `pattern: string`, `path?: string`, `include?: string` (glob filter like `*.ts`)
- Uses Node's `child_process` or execa to run `grep -rn`
- Returns matching lines with file:line format
- Max 200 results

**Glob** (`src/tools/Glob.ts`)
- Parameters: `pattern: string`, `cwd?: string`
- Uses `fast-glob` to find files
- Returns array of matching paths
- Max 500 results

**Shell** (`src/tools/Shell.ts`)
- Parameters: `command: string`, `timeout?: number` (default 30000ms)
- Executes shell command using execa
- Returns stdout + stderr
- Max output: 50000 chars (truncates)
- Timeout kills the process

**Introspect** (`src/tools/Introspect.ts`)
- Parameters: none (or `topic?: string`)
- Returns a comprehensive system info document:
  - OS info (platform, arch, hostname)
  - Current working directory
  - Environment variables (filtered, no secrets)
  - Available shell commands (which node, bun, git, etc.)
  - Current date/time
  - Memory/CPU info
  - Git status if in a git repo

```tsx
//   - ToolUseDisplay (current tool in progress, if any)

```

- Assistant messages: white text with markdown-like formatting
- Tool results: dimmed/gray, collapsible

- Uses chalk colors: yellow for running, green for done, red for error

- Shows `> ` prompt
- Disabled while agent is processing
- Ctrl+C to exit

5. **Keyboard shortcuts**: Ctrl+C exits, Ctrl+L clears screen

# Models & Pricing

The prices listed below are in units of per 1M tokens. A token, the smallest unit of text that the model recognizes, can be a word, a number, or even a punctuation mark. We will bill based on the total number of input and output tokens by the model. ## Model Details[][44]

## Deduction Rules[][50]

The expense = number of tokens × price. The corresponding fees will be directly deducted from your topped-up balance or granted balance, with a preference for using the granted balance first when both balances are available. Product prices may vary and DeepSeek reserves the right to adjust them. We recommend topping up based on your actual usage and regularly checking this page for the most recent pricing information. [

# Models & Pricing

The prices listed below are in units of per 1M tokens. A token, the smallest unit of text that the model recognizes, can be a word, a number, or even a punctuation mark. We will bill based on the total number of input and output tokens by the model. ## Model Details[][44]

**NOTE: The `deepseek-chat` and `deepseek-reasoner` correspond to the model version DeepSeek-V3. 2 (128K context limit), which differs from the APP/WEB version. **

## Deduction Rules[][50]

The expense = number of tokens × price. The corresponding fees will be directly deducted from your topped-up balance or granted balance, with a preference for using the granted balance first when both balances are available. Product prices may vary and DeepSeek reserves the right to adjust them. We recommend topping up based on your actual usage and regularly checking this page for the most recent pricing information. [

content.data:
Confirmado pela documentação oficial. A DeepSeek API expõe **apenas dois modelos**:

| Model | Versão real | Descrição |
|---|---|---|
| `deepseek-chat` | DeepSeek-V3.2 (Non-thinking) | Modo chat padrão, rápido, 8K output máx |
| `deepseek-reasoner` | DeepSeek-V3.2 (Thinking) | Modo raciocínio passo a passo, 64K output máx |

Ambos rodam o mesmo modelo base (DeepSeek-V3.2, 128K contexto), mas o `deepseek-reasoner` ativa o modo de "thinking" — equivalente ao o1 da OpenAI.

O projeto está usando `deepseek-chat`, que é a escolha certa para um assistente de código interativo. Quer trocar para `deepseek-reasoner` ou manter?
